title: Volume at leak start
description: Essential: Correctly states the volume of the lower chamber when leaking begins as V_0 = V(1+x)^{-3/5}.

title: Upper chamber temperature
description: Essential: Correctly states the final temperature in the upper chamber as T_1 = (T/2)[(1+(1+x)^{3/5})^{5/3} - x].

title: Lower chamber temperature
description: Essential: Correctly states the final temperature in the lower chamber as T_2 = T(1+(1+x)^{3/5})^{2/3}.

title: Adiabatic process application
description: Important: Applies the adiabatic condition (pV^γ = constant or TV^{γ-1} = constant) to the compression of the gas in the lower chamber before leaking.

title: Pressure balance condition
description: Important: Identifies that leaking starts when the pressure difference between chambers equals the weight of the diaphragm per area (Δp = mgH/V = px).

title: First law for upper chamber
description: Important: Applies the first law of thermodynamics (adiabatic, Q=0) and ideal gas law to relate state changes in the upper chamber after the leak.

title: Consistent variable definition
description: Optional: Correctly uses the given parameter x = mgH/(pV) in all final expressions.

title: Sign error in pressure
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for the pressure difference (e.g., p_upper = p_lower + Δp) when applying the diaphragm weight condition.

title: Adiabatic exponent mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect adiabatic index (γ) for monatomic helium (should be 5/3, not 7/5 or other).
